Title: Undo control remains permanently hidden after moves
Preconditions: Active puzzle; at least one history item
Steps: 1. Start Classic. 2. Enter any value. 3. Observe tools panel and DOM state of #undoButton.
Actual: `#undoButton` is enabled (`disabled=false`) but not visible; computed `display:none`.
Expected: Undo should be visible/enabled after an action because the control, translation, handler and history logic exist.
Player impact: Player cannot revert an accidental entry using the implemented function.
Workaround: Erase individual cell; cannot restore notes/counters atomically.
Additional: CSS has global `#undoButton { display: none; }` and no override.

Title: aria-live gameplay feedback is removed from accessibility tree by display:none
Steps: 1. Inspect `#tipText` (`aria-live=polite`). 2. Trigger a correct/wrong/notes action. 3. Check computed style.
Actual: Computed display is `none` at tested viewports; changing text is not exposed as a live region.
Expected: The live region should remain visually hidden but rendered so assistive technologies can announce gameplay feedback.
Player impact: Screen-reader users may miss given-cell, mistake, notes, hint and recovery messages.
Workaround: Some cell aria labels expose value/error, but not all feedback.
Additional: Base `.tip-text { display:none; }`; media rules add visually-hidden properties but never restore display.
